name: agent-webmcp
description: Operate local services through the bounded Agent WebMCP health, logs, metrics, and lifecycle surface.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and control local services through MCP
interface.longDescription: Use Agent WebMCP to inspect system health and metrics, list and inspect services, read bounded cursor-based service logs, and start, stop, restart, or reload services through a constrained Java MCP runtime.
defaultPrompt: Show the current system and service health.
Show the latest logs for a service and explain any failures.
Restart a service and verify its observed state afterward.
